home.ats_what_body: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software companies use to automatically screen applications. An ATS-friendly resume contains the right keywords, a clean structure, and standard sections. CVFit's templates are designed with these criteria in mind.
home.ats_how_title: How to Create an ATS-Passing Resume?
home.ats_how_body: To create a resume that passes ATS systems, add keywords from the job posting, use a clean template, and avoid tables. With CVFit Pro, AI automatically optimizes your resume for any target job posting.
